The delivery with its event and attempts

AllowedActionsDto.description:
What the caller may do with an item now, as core decides it (role, token scopes and
status): the admin shows only these actions. `true` means the request passes its
permission and transition checks; it can still fail on a stale version, a schedule
time in the past, or (`delete`) children.

trash_undoable.description:
`DELETE` is allowed and `restore` would be once the item is trashed (the admin's
Undo after a trash).

scopes.description: At least one, each in the request's `grantable`.

response_excerpt.description: At most 1 KiB of the receiver's answer, as plain text (show it escaped).

oneOf.description:
`null`: the operator path (CLI), an unauthenticated flow (password reset), or a
deleted user.

details.description: What changed (never secrets or setting values).

AuthorRefDto.description:
A user as an item's or a revision's author: id, login and display name (public on
author archives).

AutosaveDto.description:
`GET`/`PUT /content/{type}/{id}/autosave`: the caller's own unsaved working copy of
the item (one per item and user). Nothing in it has been checked against the type's
fields, the parent or the terms.

base_version.description: The item version the copy was made from.

parent_id.description: The working copy's parent; `null`: top level (not "unchanged").

oneOf.description: The SEO patch as sent; `null`: unchanged.

AutosaveInput.description:
`PUT /content/{type}/{id}/autosave`: replaces the caller's autosave (last write
wins; no `If-Match`). Text is checked as a content write checks it (no NUL; the slug
also no control characters; `seo` as a content write checks it, then stored as
sent), `body` must be a document (`type` `doc`) and `terms` holds at most 200 ids;
the field schema, the parent and the terms are not checked: a draft may be
incomplete.

base_version.description: The item version the working copy was made from.

excerpt.description: Absent or `null`: derive from the body.

parent_id.description:
The working copy's parent; absent or `null`: top level (not "unchanged"), so
always send it.

oneOf.description: The working copy's SEO patch; absent or `null`: unchanged.

terms.description: Term ids in order (at most 200); absent or `null`: unchanged.

CacheStatsDto.description: The page cache of the answering node.

hits.description: Lookups that found a page since the node started.

after.description: The object after (`null`: deleted, hidden or too large).

before.description: The object before (`null`: it did not exist, or hidden, or too large).

images.description: `shown`, or `hidden` when you may not read the object's area now.

revertable.description: `false` when an image was too large to keep.

admin_path.description: The admin screen of the object when it still exists (relative to `/admin`).

label.description: Its title or name at write time.

client.description: The client's name when the set opened.

connected.description: Whether the grant or token still exists.

kind.description: `oauth` (a connected app) or `token` (a personal API token).

open.description: Whether the assistant's next write still lands here.

CommentDto.description: A comment as moderators see it (`GET /comments`, `PATCH /comments/{id}`).

body.description: Plain text as submitted (trimmed; escape it when showing it).

ip_hash.description:
Keyed hash of the client address (HMAC under the site key): tells commenters
apart, cannot be reversed without the key.

item.description: That item as read with the comment.

user_id.description: The signed-in commenter; `null` for a guest (and after the account is deleted).

CommentItemDto.description: The item a comment is on (`CommentDto.item`).

permalink.description:
The public path, only while the item has a public page now (published, its
publish time reached, and not a media item: media have no page); `null`
otherwise.

title.description:
`""` for an item without a public page when the caller may not read content
(a token without `content:read`).

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

CommentPublicDto.description: A submitted comment as its author sees it: no e-mail, no address hash.

html.description:
The body as the site shows it: escaped, `

` paragraphs, `
` line breaks.

CommentSubmit.description:
`POST /content/{type}/{id}/comments`. With a session or token the name and e-mail
come from the account and these members are ignored. Unknown members are ignored.

author_email.description: At most 254 bytes; required without an account.

author_name.description: 1 to 100 characters; required without an account.

author_url.description: An `http` or `https` address of at most 200 characters.

body.description: Plain text, 1 to 10 000 characters (no HTML; line breaks kept).

parent_id.description: An approved comment of the same post to reply to (at most 5 deep).

website.description: Leave empty (a field people never see; anything in it drops the comment).

ConsentDto.description:
`GET /oauth/requests/{id}`: a pending authorization request (10 minutes) as the
consent screen shows it.

grantable.description:
The requested scopes this user can grant (preselect these); `<area>:write`
implies `<area>:read`. Never `users:write`, `import:write` or `system:write`.

id.description: The request's id (the `request` query parameter of `/admin/connect`).

redirect_host.description:
Where the browser goes back to: the host of an `http(s)` redirect URI (with a
non-default port, `app.example:8443`), `scheme://host` for another scheme, the
whole URI when it has no host.

requested.description: The requested scopes (the 19 an OAuth grant can hold when the client named none).

verified.description:
`true` when the client is known by a metadata document, `false` when it
registered itself.

ConsentRedirectDto.description:
Where the browser goes next (approve and deny): the client's redirect URI with
`code` (or `error=access_denied`), `state` and `iss`. Navigate there with
`window.location`; never fetch it.

ContentCountsDto.description:
`GET /content/{type}/counts`: items per status that the caller may read (the same
rule as the list: without `edit_others`, others' items only when publicly visible).

ContentDto.description: A content item with its terms and public path (`GET`, and every write's result).

allowed.description: What the caller may do with it now.

terms.description: Term ids in their stored order.

translation_group.description: The id of the translation group's original (the item's own id when alone).

translations.description: The other members of the item's translation group the caller may read.

version.description: What `ETag` carries and `If-Match` must send back.

ContentInput.description: `POST /content/{type}`: a new draft authored by the caller.

body.description: The block tree; an empty document when absent.

excerpt.description: Derived from the body (160 characters) when absent.

locale.description: One of the site's locales (`GET /meta`); absent: the default.

oneOf.description: SEO title and description; absent or `null`: none.

slug.description: Generated from the title when absent; a taken slug gets `-2`, `-3`, ….

terms.description: Term ids, in order; duplicates are ignored.

translation_of.description:
An item of the same type whose translation group the new item joins (its locale
must be free there, else `409`).

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

ContentPatch.description:
`PATCH /content/{type}/{id}`: every member is optional and an absent one keeps the
stored value. `null` is accepted only by `parent_id` (move to the top level) and
`excerpt` (derive it from the body again); elsewhere, `slug` included, it is
`400 malformed-json`.

locale.description:
Moves the item to another of the site's locales (a published item's old path
redirects; not for an item with children).

seo.description:
Changes the SEO meta member by member; a change to it alone is a full save
(a new version and revision).

terms.description: Replaces the item's terms; `[]` removes them all.

translation_of.description: Joins the translation group of this item; `null` leaves the group.

permalink.description:
The public path; `null` unless the item has a public page now (published, not
future-dated, not media).

ContentRefList.description:
`GET /content/refs`: the requested items the caller may read, in no particular
order; unknown and unreadable ids are absent.

ContentSummaryDto.description: A list entry: the item's columns without `body`.

allowed.description: What the caller may do with it now.

translations.description: The other members of its translation group the caller may read.

fields.description:
The field schema items are validated against; `[]` means items take `{}` only
(plus `featured_image`). `null`: the type has no schema and its items take any
`fields` object (the built-in types until one is set).

hierarchical.description: Whether items can have a parent (cannot change).

fields.description:
The schema; absent is `[]` (items take `{}` only), `null` registers the type
without a schema (items take any object).

name.description:
`[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}`; not a router word, type, taxonomy or top-level post or
page slug, and not a first segment of a permalink structure.

next_cursor.description: Always `null`: one page holds every type.

fields.description:
Absent keeps the schema, a list replaces it (`[]`: items take `{}` only), `null`
removes it (items take any object). Stored items are validated on their next save.

CreatedTokenDto.description:
The created token. `token` is the bearer value (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`),
shown **only in this response**; it cannot be read again.

CreatedWebhookDto.description: `201` of `POST /webhooks`: the endpoint and its secret, shown this once.

secret.description: `whsec_…`: store it now; it is never shown again.

DeliveryDto.description: One delivery (one event for this endpoint).

event_id.description: The event id, also the `webhook-id` header of every attempt.

last_error.description: The error class of the last attempt (`status 503`, `timed out`, …).

EventTypeDto.description: One event type of the catalogue.

FailureBucketDto.description: Failures of one hook in one hour, every node's (the shared counters, P20).

FieldDefDto.description:
One field of a content type's schema. Names match `[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}` and are
unique per level; at most 100 fields per level; `featured_image` is a core field that
every schema allows and none may define.

fields.description:
The sub-fields of a `repeater` (repeaters nest at most 2 deep); empty for every
other kind.

options.description: The choices of a `select` (1 to 100); empty for every other kind.

types.description:
The content types a `relation` may point at: distinct registered type names,
never `media`; empty means any type. Empty for every other kind. A relation
value whose item has another type is refused (`422`, `errors[0].field` at the
value's path, such as `fields.chapters[1].related`); a missing item is accepted.
Left out of an answer when empty, as the stored schema leaves it out.

FieldError.description:
One entry of `errors`: what is wrong with one input (`field` = the JSON path or
parameter name, when known).

FieldKindDto.description: The kind of a custom field.

GrantDto.description: A connected app: one grant of a user to a client.

created_at.description: When the user connected the app.

expires_at.description: When the connection ends unless used again (30 days after its last use).

last_used_at.description: When the app last refreshed its access (about hourly while in use).

GrantList.description: `GET /oauth/grants`: a user's connected apps, newest first.

GrantReportDto.description:
A permission report: what a manifest asks for in plain language, against a grant
(P3, P6).

added.description:
What the grant compared against does not cover: for an upload, the installed
version's grant (all of `items` for a new plugin; a non-empty `added` on an
update widens the grant, R1); for an installed plugin, its own stored grant
(empty when it was installed with approval).

fingerprint.description:
For an upload: what `POST /plugins` must carry as `approve` to install exactly
it (SHA-256 over plugin, version, artifact and grant). For an installed plugin:
the fingerprint it was approved with.

HookStatsDto.description: One hook's calls on the answering node since it started.

buckets.description: Calls that ran by duration: at most 1, 5, 25, 100 and 500 ms, and longer.

budget_cut.description: Calls cut short or skipped by the page's render budget (not failures).

busy.description: Calls skipped for want of a call slot (not failures).

calls.description: Calls that ran (successes, failures and budget cuts).

total_micros.description: Summed duration of the calls that ran, in microseconds.

ImportCountsDto.description: What happened to the items of one kind.

kept.description: Edited here since the last import: kept.

ImportJobDto.description:
An import job (`GET /import/jobs/{job_id}`): poll it until `status` is `done` or
`dead`.

last_error.description: Why the last attempt failed, scrubbed (the node's log has the full text).

oneOf.description: The run the job started; `null` until it starts one.

ImportOptionsDto.description: The import's options; a missing field takes the CLI's default.

category_base.description: The old site's category base, for redirects. Default `category`.

dry_run.description: Run everything, then roll every write back. Default `false`.

fetch_media.description: Fetch attachments missing from `uploads` from the old site. Default `false`.

keep_permalinks.description: Take the old site's post permalink structure. Default `true`.

site_options.description: Import the site title and description. Default `true`.

tag_base.description: The old site's tag base, for redirects. Default `tag`.

created.description: Rows whose source had no redirect.

updated.description: Rows that replaced the target and code of an existing redirect.

counts.description: Outcomes per kind (`posts`, `pages`, `media`, …), as far as the run got.

heartbeat_at.description: Moves while it runs; a `running` run without one for 120 s has stopped.

job_id.description: The import job that ran it; `null` for a CLI run.

step.description: The step it is in or ended in: `parse`, `pass1` … `pass4`, `fixup` or `report`.

oneOf.description: At most 4 KiB of JSON; every field is optional.

uploads.description: A `.zip` of the old site's `wp-content/uploads`, at most 4 GiB.

wxr.description:
The WordPress export (Tools → Export), at most 512 MiB; stored as sent (not
sniffed). Its part's file name names the run in the admin.

oneOf.description: How the installed version arrived; `null` for one installed before M6-2.

state.description:
`verified` (a registry publisher's key), `signed` (a key of this site),
`unsigned`, or `revoked` (its signing key is revoked).

JobDto.description:
A job, without its payload (P19): a handler's input can hold anything, and an
operator needs the state, not the data.

attempts.description: Claims so far (including the current one while `running`).

handled.description:
Some live node runs jobs of this kind (its `meta.job_kinds`). `false`: the job
waits until a node that knows the kind joins (e.g. one running a newer
version, or with the plugin's handler). `null`: unknown; only a retry answers
it, when the node list could not be read after the retry committed.

last_error.description:
Why the last attempt failed, scrubbed of URLs, paths, addresses and credentials
(the node's log has the full text); kept by a retry.

run_at.description: When it is due (the next attempt, while `queued`).

LimitItemDto.description: One `[limits]` request against the host default and the approval ceiling.

label.description: What the language switcher shows (1–50 characters; default the native name).

tag.description:
A BCP 47 tag `language[-Script][-REGION]` (e.g. `de`, `pt-BR`); its lowercase is
the URL prefix of a non-default locale.

LocaleTextDto.description: The texts of one locale in `site.locale_texts`.

oneOf.description: Logged in; the session cookie is set.

The account uses TOTP: send a code with `challenge` to `POST /auth/login/totp`
within 5 minutes.

LoginResponse.description: The result of a correct password (`status` tells which).

MailStatusDto.description:
Outgoing mail (P49): `[mail]` in `ferrite.toml` is the only place to set it; the SMTP
URL (it can hold credentials) is never shown.

configured.description:
`[mail]` has `smtp_url` and `from`: password resets, plugin `notify-admins` and
the test mail can send.

to.description: The actor's own address, where the mail goes.

MeDto.description: The authenticated user and what the request's credential allows.

capabilities.description: Capabilities granted by the role and the credential's scopes (07 §1 names).

csrf_token.description: The `X-CSRF-Token` for this session's unsafe requests; `null` for a bearer token.

must_reset.description:
Only `GET /auth/me`, `POST /auth/logout` and `POST /auth/password` are open until
the password is changed.

scopes.description: The credential's scopes (a session holds every scope).

MediaDto.description: A media item (`GET`, and every write's result).

author.description: Who uploaded it (the same as `author_id`, with the login and display name).

mime.description: Decided from the content at upload, never from the client's claim.

original_name.description: The uploaded file's name (last path segment only).

sanitized.description: The stored bytes are the SVG sanitiser's output.

status.description: `published` from the upload on; `trash` once trashed.

variants.description: The resized copies, by name (empty until they are made).

version.description: What `ETag` carries and `If-Match` must send back.

width.description: Set once the variants are made (raster images only).

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

MediaPatchInput.description:
`PATCH /media/{id}`: the members sent are changed, the others kept. Unknown members
are ignored.

title.description: At most 200 characters; blank keeps an empty title.

MediaUpload.description:
`POST /media` (`multipart/form-data`; the schema only). Parts in any order; an
unknown or repeated one is refused.

file.description:
The file, streamed (at most `media.max_upload`; its part's file name is kept as
`original_name`). Its type is decided from its content.

title.description: At most 200 characters; absent or blank: the file name without its extension.

MediaVariantDto.description: One resized copy of a media item.

name.description: The size's name (`thumbnail`, `medium`, `large`, or a theme's size).

MenuDto.description: A menu with its entries in tree order (roots first, each followed by its children).

name.description: Lowercase, no whitespace or `/` (a theme's menu location, e.g. `primary`).

translation_of.description: The default-locale menu this one translates (`primary` for `primary-de`).

MenuInput.description:
`PUT /menus/{name}`: the whole menu (the path names it; a `name` member, if sent,
must match).

locale.description: One of the site's locales; absent: the stored menu's (a new menu: the default).

translation_of.description: The name of the default-locale menu this one translates; absent or `null`: none.

MenuItemDto.description:
One menu entry. The tree is flat: `parent_id` names another entry of the same menu
(`null` for a top-level one), and siblings are ordered by `position`, then `id`.

id.description: Chosen by the client (a new UUID for a new entry); unique across all menus.

target_id.description: The content item or term (`item`, `term`); `null` for `url`.

MenuItemKindDto.description: What a menu entry links to.

MenuList.description: `GET /menus`: every menu, by name, and the theme's menu locations.

locations.description:
The menu locations the theme this node serves declares, by name; empty when it
declares none.

next_cursor.description: Always `null`: one page holds every menu.

MenuLocationDto.description: A menu location of the theme the answering node serves (its `[menus]` table).

menu.description: Whether a menu with this name exists.

name.description: The location, and the name of the menu the theme shows there.

MenuSummary.description: A menu's name, label and locale.

translation_of.description: The default-locale menu this one translates.

MetaDto.description: The API version and the site it serves.

locales.description:
Every locale of the site, the default first (public: the `hreflang` links show
them anyway, design 13 D19).

version.description: The FerriteCMS version serving the request.

prefix.description: The URL prefix (`de` for `/de/`); `null` for the default locale.

MetricsSeriesDto.description: `GET /system/metrics/series`: every bucket of the range, ascending (dense).

from.description: The requested `from` rounded down to a bucket start (UTC, epoch-aligned).

node.description: The node filter, if one was given.

to.description: The requested `to` rounded up to a bucket end (exclusive).

MetricsSummaryDto.description:
`GET /system/metrics/summary`: a snapshot of the answering node (its counters since
it started) plus the site's job counts (P20); time series: `MetricsSeriesDto`.

renders.description: Template renders (pages and error pages) since the node started.

NodeCountsDto.description: Registered nodes by heartbeat age (live: within 30 s of the database clock).

live.description: The heartbeat is within 30 s of the database clock.

meta.description:
What the node reports (04 §8); error texts scrubbed of URLs, paths, addresses and
credentials, at most 1 KiB each.

schema_version.description: The highest migration its binary knows.

NodeList.description: `GET /system/nodes`: every registered node, live and stale, by id.

next_cursor.description: Always `null`: one page holds every node.

NodeMetaDto.description:
A node's `meta`, read leniently: every member is optional (a node of another version
in a rolling deploy may lack or add members), unknown members are dropped, and a
member of the wrong type is `null` rather than failing the list.

clock_skew_ms.description: The node clock minus the database clock at its last heartbeat, in milliseconds.

job_kinds.description: The job kinds this node's runner handles.

permalinks_error.description: Why the current permalink options are not in effect.

plugins.description: The node's plugins by name, from its last reload.

plugins_error.description: Why the plugin rows could not be read at the last reload.

site_id.description: The site the node joined (cluster registry).

error.description: Why the active theme is not served (scrubbed).

fallback.description: There is an active row and this node does not serve its artifact.

NodeThemeOrigin.description: Where a node's theme came from: `"embedded"`, `"folder"` or `{"artifact": <hash>}`.

OAuthClientDto.description:
An OAuth client as the consent screen and the connected apps show it (no redirect
URIs).

client_uri.description: The client's home page (`http(s)`), as it declared.

id.description: The `client_id`: `ferc_…`, or the metadata document's URL.

logo_uri.description: The client's logo; only ever an `https` URL.

name.description:
Control and format characters removed, at most 100 characters; written by the
client, so show it as text.

OwnerChangeDto.description: What an install does to the owner of the plugin name's data.

current.description:
The current owner (`reg:<key>:<publisher>` or `key:<key>`); `null` when unsigned
or none.

OwnerDto.description: The owner of an installed plugin's data.

csrf_token.description:
The new session's `X-CSRF-Token` (its cookie is set with this response); `null`
for a bearer request, which gets no session.

password.description: The new password: 12 to 1024 bytes, at least 12 characters.

token.description:
The `token` from the fragment of the mailed link (`…#token=<token>`), valid
1 hour and once.

PasswordSet.description: `POST /users/{id}/password`: an admin sets another user's password.

PermissionItemDto.description: One capability a manifest asks for, in plain language.

detail.description: The patterns, types, host, methods or hook name the item covers.

key.description:
`content.read`, `content.meta.read`, `content.meta.write`, `options.read`, `kv`,
`http` (one item per host), `render.head`, `render.text`, `render.html`,
`routes` (one item per route), `mail`, `hooks` (one item per action hook),
`limits.memory`, `limits.fuel` (only when above the default).

trust.description: Who signed it and whose data it gets (M6-2, design 14 §7.2).

update.description: Whether a plugin of this name is installed: `added` is then against its grant.

PermissionReportDto.description:
The report of a plugin upload, as the admin approves it (`POST /plugins/inspect`,
and the `report` of an approval refusal).

disabled_reason.description: Why it was disabled automatically (failures), if it was.

homepage.description:
The stored manifest's `plugin.homepage`: an `http://` or `https://` URL (a stored
value of another form is `null`).

nodes.description:
What each live node (heartbeat within 30 s) reports about it, by node; a node
that has not loaded the plugin yet is not listed.

oneOf.description:
The report of the stored grant: `added` is what it does not cover (empty for a
plugin installed with approval), `fingerprint` the approved one. It has no
`update`: rows keep no previous version. `null` when the stored manifest or
grant no longer parses (the plugin does not load).

trust.description: Who signed it, whose data it holds, and an update the registry offers (M6-2).

PluginInspectUpload.description:
`POST /plugins/inspect` (`multipart/form-data`; the schema only, the handler reads
the parts itself). `manifest` and `component` are required; an unknown or repeated
part is refused.

publisher_key.description:
`ferrite-plugin.pub`: the publisher's minisign public key (at most 1 KiB), for a
key this site does not know yet.

signature.description:
`ferrite-plugin.minisig`: the publisher's minisign signature over the signing
payload (UTF-8, at most 4 KiB).

next_cursor.description: Always `null`: one page holds every plugin.

failures.description: Failures per hook and hour in the window, every node's, newest hour first.

node.description: The answering node's call statistics (each node counts its own).

PluginNodeState.description: What one live node reports about a plugin (`nodes.meta.plugins.<name>`).

error.description:
The node's diagnostic, scrubbed of URLs, paths, addresses and credentials (also
when an older node stored it unscrubbed), at most 1 KiB.

name.description: The node's name (`cluster.node_name` or the host name).

version.description: The version the node last loaded the row as.

PluginSettingsDto.description:
`GET /plugins/{name}/settings`: the plugin's schema, the value of every non-secret
setting as the plugin reads it (the stored value if it fits the definition, else the
default, else `null`), for each `secret` only whether it is set, and the keys whose
stored value does not fit. A secret's value is never returned.

invalid.description:
Keys whose stored value does not fit the current definition (its type changed in
an update): they read as the default (a secret as unset) until written again.

secrets.description: Secret key -> whether a usable value is set (sealed for this plugin and key).

PluginTotalsDto.description: Plugin calls on the answering node since it started.

PluginUpload.description:
`POST /plugins` (`multipart/form-data`; the schema only). `manifest`, `component`
and `approve` are required; an unknown or repeated part is refused.

approve.description:
The `fingerprint` of the report `POST /plugins/inspect` gave for this upload (at
most 128 bytes).

ProblemDocument.description: The body of a problem response (the OpenAPI schema `ProblemDocument`).

report.description:
The permission report (`PermissionReportDto`) of the refused upload; only on a
`validation` (422) of `POST /plugins` whose `approve` does not match, so the
admin can review what this upload asks for and approve it.

PublisherKeyDto.description:
A publisher key this site knows: its own (approved, operator), the configured
registry's, and every revocation.

plugins.description: The installed or retained plugins whose current version it signed.

oneOf.description: The registry publisher that lists it.

trusted_at.description: When this site trusted it; `null` for a registry key with no row here.

PublisherRefDto.description: A registry publisher as the index names it.

QueuedDeliveryDto.description: `202` of a test delivery or a redelivery.

since.description: Deliveries created at or after this time.

source.description: The path it matches (exactly, or with the trailing slash toggled).

target.description: A local path or an absolute http(s) URL.

RedirectOriginDto.description: How a redirect came to be.

collisions.description:
Refresh only (empty otherwise): site keys whose id the index lists under other key
bytes; they were removed and the plugins they signed disabled (M6-2 review).

plugins.description: The cached index's plugins matching `q`, by name (at most 50).

version.description: Default: the newest version this binary runs, not yanked.

RegistryInstalledDto.description: A registry plugin that is installed here.

publisher_matches.description:
The registry publisher owns this plugin's data (`false`: unsigned-owned, an
update binds its data to the registry publisher).

update_available.description: A newer version this binary runs is listed (and may be installed over it).

RegistryMetaDto.description: The configured registry and its cached copy.

last_error.description: The last failed check's error, cleared by a successful one.

name.description: The index's `name`; `null` before the first successful check.

latest.description: The newest version this binary runs, not yanked; `null` when none.

versions.description: Every listed version, newest first (yanked ones included).

yanked.description: Why it was yanked; `null` when it is not.

RetainedPluginDto.description: A deleted plugin whose KV and settings are still kept (M2b-3 P47).

purge_after.description:
When the data is erased unless the plugin is installed again first: 30 days
after `deleted_at` (`POST /plugins/{name}/purge` erases it earlier).

RetainedPluginList.description: `GET /plugins/retained`: every deleted plugin whose data is kept, by name.

changes.description: The seqs to revert (at most 500); omitted: every change not reverted yet.

dry_run.description: Check and report only; nothing is written.

RevertReportDto.description: What a revert did (or, with `dry_run`, would do).

RevisionDto.description: One revision: the saved title, excerpt, body and fields.

RevisionList.description: `GET /content/{type}/{id}/revisions`: newest first, at most 50 (all that are kept).

next_cursor.description: Always `null`: one page holds every kept revision.

RevisionSummaryDto.description: A revision in a list: who saved it and when, without the content.

note.description: `restored from <revision id>` for a restore; else `null`.

compromised.description: The key was stolen or leaked: every installed plugin it signed is disabled.

reason.description: Why (1..=500 characters; shown with the key and on disabled plugins).

RobotsDto.description: A robots directive of an item's page.

previous_valid_until.description: Until then deliveries carry a signature with the previous secret too.

secret.description: The new secret, shown this once.

at.description: When to publish; must lie in the future.

binary_version.description: The highest migration this binary embeds.

pending.description: Embedded migrations not applied yet, oldest first.

SchemaVerdict.description: How the database's schema relates to this binary (02 §8).

SeoDto.description:
An item's SEO meta. `title`, when set, is the whole `<title>` and `og:title` of the
item's page (no site suffix); `description` comes before the excerpt as the meta
description; `canonical` (an absolute `http(s)` URL) replaces the page's own URL in
the canonical link and `og:url`; `robots` (sorted, deduplicated; empty: none) is the
page's `<meta name="robots">`. `null`: not set.

SeoPatchDto.description:
A change to an item's SEO meta. Per member: absent keeps it, `null` or a string
that is blank after trimming deletes it, any other string sets it (trimmed). No NUL,
and no control characters once trimmed (an edge newline is trimmed, an inner one
refused); `title` at most 200 characters and `description` at most 500 (`422`,
`errors[0].field` = `seo.title` / `seo.description`). `canonical`, trimmed, must be
an absolute `http(s)` URL of at most 2048 characters (`seo.canonical`); `robots`
replaces the directives (`null` or `[]` deletes them; an unknown one is `400`, a malformed body).

SeriesBucketDto.description:
One bucket of `GET /system/metrics/series`: the minutes starting in
`[start, start + step)`, summed over the nodes (zeros where none wrote a row).

cache_hits.description: Page cache lookups that found a page.

cache_misses.description: Page cache lookups that did not.

jobs_failed.description: Job attempts that failed (retried or dead).

p95_ms.description:
The upper bound (ms) of the latency bucket holding the 95th percentile of the
bucket's page responses (every minute's and node's together, from the summed
`page_latency`); 0 without page responses. Bounds: 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500,
1000, 2500, 5000 and 10000 (also for anything slower).

page_latency.description:
Page responses per latency bucket, 12 counts (not cumulative): at most 5, 10, 25,
50, 100, 250, 500, 1000, 2500, 5000 and 10000 ms, then over 10 s. Summed over
several buckets they give the p95 of a longer range.

page_views.description:
HTML page views: `200` answers and `304` revalidations of public pages (no bots,
previews or logged-in requests).

requests.description: Responses of every route class but `other` (health checks).

SeriesStepDto.description: The bucket width of a metrics series.

SessionDto.description:
One of the user's sessions (`GET /auth/sessions`). No user agent or address is
shown: sessions are told apart by time.

current.description: The session this request came with (end it with `POST /auth/logout`).

id.description:
An opaque id (16 hex characters) for `DELETE /auth/sessions/{id}`; never the
cookie value.

SessionList.description: `GET /auth/sessions`: the user's live sessions, newest first.

SettingDefDto.description: One declared setting: what the admin renders a form field from (05 §4c, 06 §1).

default.description: The declared default; `null` for none (always for `media` and `secret`).

options.description: The choices of a `select`; empty otherwise.

type.description:
`text` (at most 1 000 characters), `textarea` (65 536), `bool`, `number`,
`select` (one of `options`), `color` (`#rgb` / `#rrggbb`), `media` (a media item
id) or `secret` (plugins only: 1–4 096 characters, write-only).

SettingsDto.description:
The site settings (`GET /settings`, and the result of `PATCH /settings`): every key,
`null` when unset (the default applies). A `PATCH` body is an object with any of
these keys (`null` resets one to its default); an unknown key is `422`.

comments.moderation.description:
`"all"` (every guest comment is held) or `"known"` (default: a commenter with an
approved comment, by the same name and e-mail, posts directly). Under `known`
anyone who knows a regular guest's exact name and e-mail posts unmoderated as
them (as in WordPress); `"all"` closes that.

comments.per_page.description:
1..=100 (default 50): top-level comment threads per public comment page
(`?cpage=N`); each thread shows with all its approved replies.

mcp.change_sets_days.description:
1..=365 (default 90): how many days AI change sets are kept (M6-5). Not
writable over MCP.

mcp.enabled.description:
Whether the MCP endpoint (`/mcp`) and the OAuth authorization server answer
(default `true`); when off they answer `404` and existing connections stay.

reading.discourage_indexing.description: Ask search engines not to index the site (`robots.txt` disallows everything).

reading.front_page.description: The id of an existing page shown at `/`, or `null` for the post listing.

site.locale_texts.description: The site title and tagline per non-default locale, keyed by its tag.

site.locales.description:
The site's locales, the default first (1–20). A prefix that would shadow a
route, type, taxonomy or top-level page is `422`; removing a locale that still
holds content is `409` with the counts. Cannot be reset to `null`.

SettingsPatch.description:
`PATCH /themes/{name}/settings` and `PATCH /plugins/{name}/settings` (the schema
only): an object of declared keys to their new values; `null` resets a key to its
default (for a secret: deletes it). Keys not in the body stay as they are.

SignerDto.description: The key that signed a plugin.

claimed.description: The manifest's `plugin.publisher` (text; verified only when `publisher` is set).

key_id.description: 16 uppercase hex digits, as minisign prints it.

oneOf.description: The registry publisher that lists the key.

source.description:
`registry` (listed by the configured registry), `approved` (approved at an earlier
install), `operator` (`ferrite plugin keys trust`) or `new` (approving trusts it).

version.description: The FerriteCMS version of the node that answered.

content_types.description: The content types its terms apply to.

hierarchical.description: Whether terms can have a parent (cannot change).

name.description: The same rules as a type name.

next_cursor.description: Always `null`: one page holds every taxonomy.

slug.description: Unique in the taxonomy; the archive is `/{taxonomy}/{slug}/`.

translation_group.description: The id of the term translation group's original.

locale.description: One of the site's locales; absent: the default.

parent_id.description: A term of the same (hierarchical) taxonomy.

slug.description: Derived from the name when absent; a taken slug gets `-2`, `-3`, ….

translation_of.description: A term of the same taxonomy whose translation group the new term joins.

next_cursor.description: Always `null`: one page holds every term.

parent_id.description: `null` moves the term to the top level.

locale.description: One of the site's locales the term's group has no member in yet.

ThemeBundle.description:
`POST /themes` (`application/x-tar`; the schema only, the handler reads the body
itself): a ustar archive of `theme.toml`, `templates/` and `assets/`.

ThemeDto.description:
A theme: installed (a row) or embedded (no row). The manifest facts (`author`,
`license`, `homepage`, `description`, `menus`, `images`, `has_settings`) are the
row's stored manifest, or the embedded theme's `theme.toml`; each is text the theme
author wrote (render it as text).

active.description:
The theme nodes should serve: the active row, or with no row active the embedded
default (`blog`) while it has no row. With no row active and an inactive `blog`
row (uploaded without `activate`), no entry is active: nodes then serve the
embedded `blog` files, which no entry describes; activating a theme ends that.

has_settings.description: Whether `theme.toml` declares settings (`GET /themes/{name}/settings` has a form).

hash.description:
The row's artifact (SHA-256 of the bundle, 64 lowercase hex); `null` for an
embedded theme without a row.

homepage.description: An `http://` or `https://` URL (`theme.toml` refuses anything else).

images.description: The image variant sizes, by name.

installed_at.description: When the row was written; `null` for an embedded theme without a row.

nodes.description:
What each live node (heartbeat within 30 s) serves, by node; only on the active
theme (empty on the others).

ThemeImageDto.description: An image variant size a theme wants (its `[images]` table, 03 §4).

crop.description: Whether the variant is cropped to `width` x `height`.

height.description:
In pixels; `null`: scaled to `width` keeping the aspect ratio, or with `crop` a
`width` square.

name.description: The size's name (`[a-z0-9_-]`), the key of its `[images]` entry.

ThemeList.description:
`GET /themes`: every installed theme and every embedded theme without a row, by
name.

next_cursor.description: Always `null`: one page holds every theme.

ThemeMenuDto.description: A menu location a theme declares (its `[menus]` table).

name.description: The location, and the name of the menu the theme shows there.

error.description:
Why the node could not serve the active theme, if it could not (scrubbed as
[`PluginNodeState::error`]).

fallback.description:
The node does not serve the active row's artifact: the startup fallback, or the
previous theme after a failed swap (pre-flight F12). `false` when no theme is
active and the embedded default serves.

hash.description: The served files' content hash (as in `/_theme/<hash>/` asset URLs).

node_name.description: The node's name (`cluster.node_name` or the host name).

node_version.description: The binary version the node runs.

origin.description:
Where the node's files came from: `artifact` (the row's bundle), `folder`
(`<data>/themes/<name>/`, solo only) or `embedded`.

ThemeOrigin.description: Where a listed theme comes from.

ThemeSettingsDto.description:
`GET /themes/{name}/settings`: the theme's schema and every declared setting's value
as its templates see it (the stored value, else the default, else the type's empty
value).

active.description:
The active theme row; `null`: none is active and nodes serve the embedded
default.

fallback_nodes.description:
Names of the live nodes that do not serve the active row's artifact
(`nodes.meta.theme.fallback`, 06 §1).

TokenDto.description: An API token's metadata (never its bearer value or hash).

expires_at.description: In the future; `null` or absent: never expires.

scopes.description: At least one `<area>:<read|write>`, each held by the request's own credential.

TokenList.description: `GET /users/{id}/tokens`: every token of the user, oldest first.

next_cursor.description: Always `null`: one page holds every token (at most 50 per user).

password.description:
The account's current password: a stolen session alone cannot enroll another
authenticator.

TotpSetupDto.description:
A started TOTP enrollment: show the URL (as a QR code) or the secret, then confirm a
code with `enrollment` within 10 minutes.

locale.description: The target locale (one of the site's, not the item's).

TranslationCreated.description: The new translation (`201`) and what it could not take over.

TranslationRefDto.description: Another item of a translation group.

TranslationStatusDto.description: A list row's translation: its locale and status.

TrustDto.description: The trust part of a permission report (design 14 §7.2).

oneOf.description: Set when an install would be refused.

TrustRefusalDto.description: A trust refusal (the install would be refused with this `422`).

UpdateDto.description: An update the cached registry index offers for an installed plugin.

publisher_matches.description:
Whether the registry's publisher is this plugin's owner (`false` for an
unsigned-owned plugin: updating binds its data to that publisher).

UserDto.description:
A user account. Only the user themselves and accounts with `manage_users` can read
one, so `email` is never shown to anyone else.

must_reset.description: The password must be changed at the next login.

login.description: `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,59}$` after trimming and lowercasing; cannot change later.

must_reset.description: Force a password change at the next login (default `false`).

password.description:
12 to 1024 bytes, at least 12 characters. Without it the account cannot log in
until an admin sets one (`POST /users/{id}/password`).

UserPatchInput.description:
`PATCH /users/{id}`: merged into the stored account. Role and status cannot change
on oneself; the last active admin cannot be demoted or disabled.

current_password.description:
The request's own current password. Required when a user changes their **own**
`email` to a different address (missing: `422`, `errors[0].field` =
`current_password`; wrong: `403 forbidden`; checked on the same per-login rate
limit as `POST /auth/password`); ignored otherwise, so an admin changing another
user's e-mail sends none.

login.description:
Logins never change: the stored login is accepted (and ignored), any other value
is `422` (`errors[0].field` = `login`).

UserStatusDto.description: Whether the account can log in.

content_types.description: Content types `content.*` events are narrowed to; `null` for all.

counts_24h.description: Deliveries created in the last 24 hours, by status.

failing_since.description: Since the first failed attempt after a success (cleared by a `2xx`).

secret_rotating_until.description: Until when the previous secret still signs (a rotation in progress).

url.description:
The whole URL (a deploy hook may carry a token in it): shown to `webhooks:read`
callers only; the audit log holds its host.

data.description: The event's `data` as stored (`url` is added at delivery): a JSON object.

content_types.description:
Narrows `content.*` events to these content types (1 to 50); absent or `null`
for all.

secret.description:
Bring your own secret: `whsec_` + base64 of 24 to 64 bytes. Generated when
absent.

url.description: Absolute `https` URL (no user information, no fragment, at most 2048 bytes).

WebhookPatch.description:
`PATCH /webhooks/{id}`: absent members keep the stored value; `content_types: null`
clears the filter; `enabled: true` re-enables (and un-pauses) the endpoint.

WebhookStateDto.description: What state an endpoint is in.

session.name: __Host-ferrite_session
session.description: The session cookie set by `POST /auth/login`. Its name follows the scheme of `site.url`: `__Host-ferrite_session` on an `https` site, `ferrite_session` on an `http` site; only that name is read.
